name: yayatoh
label: Yayatoh
description: Events, orders, attendees and check-in from Yayatoh. Generated from the /v1 OpenAPI document.

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.label: API key
parameters.help: Create one under Settings → API keys with the scopes your scenario needs (triggers need webhooks:manage).

modules.name: watch_event_archived
modules.label: Watch: An event was archived
modules.description: It is hidden from lists; its data is kept. `from` and `to` are the event’s status before and after.

modules.name: watch_event_cancelled
modules.label: Watch: An event was cancelled
modules.description: Refunds follow the organizer’s policy (`order.refunded` per order). `from` and `to` are the event’s status before and after.

modules.name: watch_event_completed
modules.label: Watch: An event was marked as completed
modules.description: It is over; reports are final. `from` and `to` are the event’s status before and after.

modules.name: watch_event_created
modules.label: Watch: An event was created (new, duplicated or from a template)
modules.description: The event starts as a draft. `profile` is its kind (concert, gala, conference…).

modules.name: watch_event_occurrence_cancelled
modules.label: Watch: One date of a recurring event was cancelled
modules.description: `startsAt` is when the cancelled date was due to start.

modules.name: watch_event_postponed
modules.label: Watch: An event was postponed
modules.description: The date is to be announced; ticket holders keep their tickets. `from` and `to` are the event’s status before and after.

modules.name: watch_event_published
modules.label: Watch: An event was published
modules.description: It is on sale and visible according to its visibility. `from` and `to` are the event’s status before and after.

modules.name: watch_event_rescheduled
modules.label: Watch: A postponed event has a new date
modules.description: Read the event for its new `startsAt`. `from` and `to` are the event’s status before and after.

modules.name: watch_event_unpublished
modules.label: Watch: An event was taken offline
modules.description: It went back to draft; its page and sales are closed. `from` and `to` are the event’s status before and after.

modules.name: watch_event_updated
modules.label: Watch: An event’s details changed
modules.description: `fields` names what changed (for example `startsAt`); read the event for the new values.

modules.name: watch_form_registration_submitted
modules.label: Watch: A registration form was submitted
modules.description: The answers are never in the payload; they stay in the console. `formVersion` is the form version answered.

modules.name: watch_order_dispute_closed
modules.label: Watch: A dispute was decided
modules.description: A lost dispute cancels the order’s live tickets.

modules.name: watch_order_disputed
modules.label: Watch: A buyer disputed a payment (chargeback)
modules.description: Evidence can be submitted from the console before the provider’s deadline.

modules.name: watch_order_expired
modules.label: Watch: An unpaid order expired and released its tickets
modules.description: The checkout hold ran out before payment; the held tickets went back on sale.

modules.name: watch_order_paid
modules.label: Watch: An order was paid and its tickets issued
modules.description: Sent once per order when payment completes (online, at the box office, by invoice, or a free order). `via` says how it was paid. Read the order and its tickets with `GET /v1/orgs/{org}/orders/{orderId}`.

modules.name: watch_order_payment_failed
modules.label: Watch: A payment attempt for an order failed
modules.description: The buyer can try again until the order expires.

modules.name: watch_order_refunded
modules.label: Watch: All or part of an order was refunded
modules.description: Sent for each refund. `fully` is true when nothing is left to refund; `tickets` counts the tickets the refund cancelled.

modules.name: watch_program_agenda_published
modules.label: Watch: An event’s agenda was published
modules.description: `agendaVersion` increases with each publish; read the agenda from the public content API.

modules.name: watch_review_submitted
modules.label: Watch: An attendee rated an event
modules.description: `rating` is 1 to 5. The review text is not in the payload.

modules.name: watch_survey_responded
modules.label: Watch: A survey was answered
modules.description: The answers stay in the console; the payload says which survey and invitation.

modules.name: watch_ticket_type_archived
modules.label: Watch: A ticket type was archived
modules.description: It is no longer sold; tickets already issued stay valid.

modules.name: watch_ticket_type_created
modules.label: Watch: A ticket type was added to an event
modules.description: Read it with `GET /v1/orgs/{org}/events/{eventId}/ticket-types`.

modules.name: watch_ticket_type_updated
modules.label: Watch: A ticket type changed
modules.description: `fields` names what changed (for example `priceMinor`).

modules.name: watch_ticket_admission_undone
modules.label: Watch: A scan was undone
modules.description: Door staff reversed an admission (a mistaken scan); the ticket can be scanned again.

modules.name: watch_ticket_admitted
modules.label: Watch: A ticket was scanned in
modules.description: `day` is the event day in the event’s time zone. `offline` is true when a door device scanned without a connection and synced later.

modules.name: watch_ticket_claimed
modules.label: Watch: A distributed ticket was claimed by its guest
modules.description: Sent when someone opens a claim link and takes the ticket.

modules.name: watch_ticket_transferred
modules.label: Watch: A ticket moved to a new holder
modules.description: The previous QR code stops working; `rev` is the ticket’s new revision. The new holder’s details are not in the payload.

modules.name: watch_tickets_cancelled
modules.label: Watch: Tickets were cancelled in bulk
modules.description: One message per bulk cancellation (`operationId`) or per voided invoice (`orderId`: M5.1d pay later), with the ids of the tickets it voided. Exactly one of `operationId` and `orderId` is present.

modules.name: watch_waitlist_joined
modules.label: Watch: Someone joined an event’s waitlist
modules.description: Who joined is not in the payload.

modules.name: watch_waitlist_offered
modules.label: Watch: A waitlist entry was offered a place
modules.description: `offer` counts the offers this entry has had (1 for the first).

modules.name: addContact
modules.label: Add a contact
modules.description: Finds or creates the org’s contact for the email; an existing contact keeps its name unless it had none. Records no marketing consent.

modules.name: bulkAssignSeats
modules.label: Seat many attendees at once
modules.description: Select attendees by `ids` (all must belong to the event, else 404) or by a list `filter`, resolved once when the operation starts (at most 50,000). Retrying with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same operation; another body with that key is 422. Seats them at a table or row, in a section, in the best available seats or in their group's block, in plan order. Per-person failures: `not_enough_seats`, `seated_by_ticket`, `attendee_cancelled`, `not_found`; a kept-back accessible seat is a warning (`ada_kept_back`). Undo within 10 minutes puts everyone back.

expect.name: target
expect.label: Target
expect.help: A table or row (`item`), a section, the best available seats, or a group’s block.

expect.name: overrideRules
expect.label: Override rules
expect.help: Use accessible seats an enforced rule keeps back (audited).

modules.name: bulkCancelTickets
modules.label: Cancel tickets without a refund
modules.description: Voids the named attendees’ tickets (scanners reject them), cancels the attendees and returns their places and seats to sale. No money moves: refunds stay per order. It cannot be undone, so only explicit `ids` are accepted, never a filter.

modules.name: bulkEmailAttendees
modules.label: Email many attendees about the event
modules.description: Select attendees by `ids` (all must belong to the event, else 404) or by a list `filter`, resolved once when the operation starts (at most 50,000). Retrying with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same operation; another body with that key is 422. One email per attending person; the others fail `not_attending`. Refused while messaging is paused for the organization.

modules.name: bulkLabelAttendees
modules.label: Add or remove labels on many attendees
modules.description: Select attendees by `ids` (all must belong to the event, else 404) or by a list `filter`, resolved once when the operation starts (at most 50,000). Retrying with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same operation; another body with that key is 422. Removal wins over addition; an attendee carries at most 20 labels (`too_many_labels`). Undo within 10 minutes restores each attendee's previous labels.

modules.name: bulkResendTickets
modules.label: Email attendees their tickets again
modules.description: Select attendees by `ids` (all must belong to the event, else 404) or by a list `filter`, resolved once when the operation starts (at most 50,000). Retrying with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same operation; another body with that key is 422. Each ticket holder gets one email with a fresh link to their tickets. Guests without a ticket fail `no_ticket`; void tickets fail `ticket_void`.

modules.name: checkInTicket
modules.label: Scan a ticket online and get the door verdict
modules.description: The same engine as the Scan PWA. Retrying with the same Idempotency-Key returns the first verdict instead of a duplicate.

expect.name: code
expect.label: Code
expect.help: The QR payload (`yy1…`) or the printed short code.

modules.name: createEvent
modules.label: Create a draft event
modules.description: Creates a draft event. Times are instants; `timezone` is how they render. Needs an `Idempotency-Key`.

modules.name: createRegistration
modules.label: Register someone for an event
modules.description: Adds a person to the event’s guest list (no ticket, no payment). One active registration per email per event: a second one is a 409.

modules.name: createTicketType
modules.label: Add a ticket type
modules.description: Adds a ticket type (prices in minor units). Needs an `Idempotency-Key`.

modules.name: getEvent
modules.label: One event
modules.description: One event of the organization; another org’s event is a 404.

modules.name: getEventAgenda
modules.label: An event’s agenda
modules.description: Tracks, rooms and sessions grouped by day in the event’s timezone, with ids and capacities.

expect.name: dateId
expect.label: Date id
expect.help: Only this date’s sessions (and those on no date), for multi-date events.

modules.name: getEventAttendee
modules.label: One attendee
modules.description: One attendee of the event.

modules.name: getEventSpeaker
modules.label: One speaker
modules.description: A speaker and the sessions they speak in.

modules.name: getOrder
modules.label: One order with its tickets
modules.description: One order with its line items and tickets.

modules.name: getVenue
modules.label: One venue
modules.description: A saved venue.

modules.name: listEventAnnouncements
modules.label: An event’s announcements
modules.description: Every announcement, newest first: drafts (`publishedAt` null) and both audiences.

modules.name: listEventAttendees
modules.label: The event’s attendees, newest first
modules.description: The event’s attendees, newest first, optionally filtered by a search term or status.

modules.name: listEventDates
modules.label: An event’s dates
modules.description: The dates of a multi-date event in start order, with capacities.

modules.name: listEventExhibitors
modules.label: An event’s exhibitors
modules.description: Exhibitors by name.

modules.name: listEventOrders
modules.label: The event’s orders, newest first
modules.description: The event’s orders, newest first, without payment-provider internals.

modules.name: listEvents
modules.label: Events by start time
modules.description: The organization’s events by start time, every status and visibility.

modules.name: listEventSections
modules.label: An event’s content sections
modules.description: Every content section in page order, hidden ones included (`visible`).

modules.name: listEventSpeakers
modules.label: An event’s speakers
modules.description: Speakers by name.

modules.name: listEventSponsors
modules.label: An event’s sponsor tiers
modules.description: Every sponsor tier in display order (empty ones included) with its sponsors.

modules.name: listHookSamples
modules.label: A sample delivery for an event type
modules.description: Example data with the delivery’s exact shape, for setting up an automation before a real event happens.

modules.name: listTicketTypes
modules.label: The event’s ticket types
modules.description: Every ticket type of the event in display order, with sold and held counts.

modules.name: listVenues
modules.label: The organization’s venues
modules.description: Saved venues by name, archived ones included (`archivedAt`).

modules.name: publishEvent
modules.label: Publish a draft event
modules.description: Publishes a draft event (lifecycle `draft → published`). Needs an `Idempotency-Key`.

modules.name: refundOrder
modules.label: Refund tickets or an amount under the refund policy
modules.description: Refunds whole tickets or an amount under the event’s refund policy, through the payment provider. Needs an `Idempotency-Key`; a retry returns the first result.

modules.name: searchAttendees
modules.label: Search attendees across events by name or email
modules.description: Attendees across the organization’s events matching a name or email. Limited to 60 per minute.

expect.name: q
expect.label: Q
expect.help: Part of a name or email (2+ characters)

modules.name: subscribeHook
modules.label: Subscribe a URL to one event type
modules.description: A REST hook (Zapier-style): deliveries are the same signed, thin messages as Settings → Webhooks endpoints. It appears there too, where the organizer can remove it.

expect.name: url
expect.label: Url
expect.help: Where to deliver: https on port 443, a public host.

expect.name: event
expect.label: Event
expect.help: A public event type (see the `webhooks` section).

modules.name: unsubscribeHook
modules.label: Unsubscribe a REST hook
modules.description: Removes a hook made through this API (never an endpoint the organizer made). A hook that is already gone answers 204 too.

modules.name: updateEvent
modules.label: Change an event
modules.description: Changes the fields given; the slug is frozen once published. Needs an `Idempotency-Key`.

modules.name: updateTicketType
modules.label: Change a ticket type
modules.description: Changes the fields given. Needs an `Idempotency-Key`.
